title: What Self-Healing Metals Is
definition: Self-Healing Metals: metals repairing their own cracks.
description:

title: Real Research Today: Self-Healing Metals

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as metal logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Self-Healing Metals
definition: Estimates Self-Healing Metals readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Self-Healing Metals components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a metal hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Self-Healing Metals Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Self-Healing Metals operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Self-Healing Metals installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 92068 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where healing alloys monitoring, metal logistics redundancy, or precipitate healing maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Self-Healing Metals Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Self-Healing Metals: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Self-Healing Metals — metals repairing their own cracks.

Phase 1 — Prove (healing alloys): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (metal logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (precipitate healing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (fatigue life): metal hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and aerospace-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
